name: self_description_v2
note: v1's five sentences, unchanged so the two variants stay comparable, plus the three answers the base variant never used: satisfaction with EU membership (Q18), with NATO membership (Q17), and covid vaccination (Q23). The wording follows the survey's own questions - "s tím, že ... je členem" is how they are asked. Nothing here needs a flag: a respondent whose data lacks these columns renders exactly v1, and a nevím or nechci uvést answer drops its own sentence. The satisfied and vaccinated filters are row-aware because both answers are adjectives that agree with gender.
sentences: Žiji {region|in}, v okresu {district} a obci o velikosti {town_size}.

{opinion_on_eu|satisfied} s tím, že je Česká republika členem Evropské unie.
